improvements.description: Add a gate check that flags artifact path mismatches (for example expected root-level lineage file vs actual `patches/` location) with auto-suggested fallback paths.
improvements.why_needed: This validation required manual path reconciliation for `patch_lineage.json` and `full_series_validation.json`.
improvements.success_metric: No manual path workaround needed in downstream validation runs.

improvements.description: Teach scoring/PM rollups to reconcile partial compile artifacts with later full-build artifacts and emit a single effective compile status.
improvements.why_needed: A.1 has both `COMPILE_NOT_RUN_ENVIRONMENT` and `FULL_BUILD_PASS`, which can be misread without explicit precedence.
improvements.success_metric: One canonical compile verdict per run with documented evidence precedence.

improvements.description: Add a reusable LA-to-LE rule block in conversion/review prompts that explicitly forbids sibling-codec SDW ID inference.
improvements.why_needed: WCD938x learning repeatedly shows identity pattern reuse is valid but numeric tuple reuse is not.
improvements.success_metric: All future WCD-family prompts include explicit identity fail-closed instruction.

improvements.description: Add a DT normalization checklist item set that maps LA property names to LE property names and blocks unresolved legacy properties.
improvements.why_needed: DT property translation remains a recurring risk area and drives checkpatch undocumented-string warnings.
improvements.success_metric: No LA-only DT properties remain unclassified in AURA conversion outputs.

improvements.description: Require PM summaries to include an explicit `what must NOT be claimed` section whenever runtime blockers exist.
improvements.why_needed: This keeps RFC compile-readiness from being misinterpreted as runtime readiness.
improvements.success_metric: Every PM summary for blocked runs has explicit non-claims section.

improvements.description: Add a verifier rule that ensures runtime fail-closed items are carried forward unchanged unless new runtime evidence artifacts are present.
improvements.why_needed: Prevents silent relaxation of SDW/Class-H/runtime blockers based on static pattern mining alone.
improvements.success_metric: Any blocker status change requires linked runtime evidence ID and source path.

improvements.description: Extend anti-hack detector patterns for reset-in-hw_params and ad-hoc re-enumeration recovery logic in codec conversions.
improvements.why_needed: WCD938x learning and WCD9378 A.1 both confirm these are common unsafe bring-up shortcuts.
improvements.success_metric: No converted output includes blocked workaround signatures without explicit runtime waiver.

improvements.description: Standardize evidence checklist schema to always require command, output file, and acceptance criteria fields per evidence item.
improvements.why_needed: Improves replayability of Monday evidence collection and reduces ambiguity for hardware engineers.
improvements.success_metric: All evidence packages are directly executable with no missing command details.
